Wire into strategist.evaluate: build MemoryContext once per game via store.QueryMemory (cache on strategist, invalidate on Reset), pass to GenerateDoctrine. Map size classification helper. close_reason: Memory retrieval + prompt injection wired. doctrine.baml gains MemoryContext/PastDoctrineExample/MemoryLesson classes and GenerateDoctrine takes optional memory param — prompt section injects lessons + past doctrines as advisory. title: Retrospective: ReviewGame BAML + game-end archival

Wire into Agent.HandleGameEnd: synchronous snapshot of strategist history under lock before Reset, then async goroutine calls ReviewGame and store.ArchiveGame + ArchiveLessons. Failure path: archive with null review/quality. See plan section 3.
close_reason: Retrospective wired: baml_src/retrospective.baml defines GameReview/TurningPoint/DoctrineRating/RetroLesson + ReviewGame function using CustomHaiku. Agent.HandleGameEnd snapshots history under lock pre-Reset and launches async goroutine that calls ReviewGame then store.ArchiveGame + ArchiveLessons. On LLM failure the game is still archived with null review/quality. Extracted buildArchival as pure helper; tests cover rating attribution by doctrine name and end-to-end archival.

close_reason: Storage foundation implemented: sqlite + sqlc + goose. Schema (games, archived_doctrines, lessons) via embedded migrations. Store API: ArchiveGame/ArchiveLessons/QueryMemory plus legacy RecordGame/Wins/Losses/Games. Tests pass (:memory: SQLite). make generate wires baml + sqlc.

title: Dashboard memory views
description: Add memory library page (paginated archived games, filter by faction/opponent, summary + turning points on click) and lessons panel (top-N by confidence) to vimy-core/server. Optional: GetCurrentMemoryContext for debugging retrieval quality. See plan section 6.
close_reason: Dashboard memory panel added. New templ component MemoryPanel shows top-8 lessons (by confidence) and recent-10 archived games with quality-tag badges, win/loss, matchup, duration, and review summary (extracted from JSON). Polls /api/memory/panel every 30s via htmx. New store methods TopLessons + RecentGames with supporting ListTopLessons sqlc query. Templ generate added to Makefile. Smoke-tested: endpoint returns expected empty-state HTML on a fresh DB.

value: Database work in this project uses sqlc for query generation + goose for migrations. sqlc reads the goose migrations directory as its schema source (one source of truth). Generation step belongs in vimy-core/Makefile 'generate' target alongside baml-cli generate. Pure-Go SQLite driver modernc.org/sqlite (no cgo).
